title: vivo V80 Lite with 10,000mAh battery to debut on September 3

Now, the official vivo Malaysia website has confirmed the phone’s launch, albeit with a different design. vivo Malaysia has announced that the V80 Lite 5G will launch in the country on September 3. The company has also confirmed that the phone will pack a 10,000mAh battery. The company has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone. title: Poco M8x arrives with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, a 120Hz display, and a 7,900 mAh battery
description: Poco today unveiled the Poco M8x as the newest member of its M8 series. The Poco M8x is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, making it India's first smartphone to have that chip at the helm. It has up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 storage, expandable via a microSD card. On the software side, the M8x runs Android 16-based HyperOS 3, with Poco promising four generations of Android OS upgrades and six years of security updates. title: OnePlus tipped to launch a new budget phone in India
description: After announcing its exit from North America and Europe, OnePlus reaffirmed its commitment to India and said it would continue launching new smartphones in the country. Following the OnePlus N6x launch last month, a new rumor now claims that the company is preparing to unveil another budget phone soon. Tipster Yogesh Brar claimed in a post on X that OnePlus is planning to launch a new budget smartphone in India. The handset is reportedly set to be a 4G-only device. title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro's India launch timeframe announced, color options revealed
description: The Infinix Hot 70 Pro, unveiled last month, will debut in India soon. Infinix hasn't revealed the Hot 70 Pro's India launch date yet, but said it will arrive in India in the first week of September. Infinix also confirmed that the Hot 70 Pro will be sold through Flipkart in India and will come in four colors - Mirage Green, Dive Blue, Silk Glow Purple, and Thermo Orange. The Infinix Hot 70 Pro's Thermo Orange model features a back panel that changes color with temperature, while Mirage Green has a finish that "transforms under nighttime conditions." title: Here's when Nothing OS 5.0 based on Android 17 is getting unveiled
description: Ever since Google released Android 17, you may have been wondering when Nothing will release its own interpretation of the new OS. Well, we are getting closer. The company has just announced that Nothing OS 5.0, which will be based on Android 17, is "coming soon". But wait, there's more. The company says it will announce something related to the new Nothing OS 5.0 release on August 25 at 11:00 AM BST, which is 12:00 PM in Central Europe and 3:30 PM in India. title: Poco F9 Ultra runs Geekbench confirming its chipset and RAM amount
description: The Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra are coming soon, it seems, with the number of leaks about them increasing in the past week. Now, the Ultra appears to have run Geekbench 7, achieving a single-core score of 2,980 and a multi-core score of 10,030. It's powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired in the specific prototype which ran the benchmark with 16GB of RAM, but of course we assume other memory options will be available upon launch. title: Counterpoint: European smartphone shipments drop to three year low
description: The European smartphone market experienced its lowest volume of shipments for Q2 (April – June) since 2023. A new report from Counterpoint Research estimates 35 million smartphone shipments for the period, which is a 10% drop from the values seen last year. Factors like spiraling inflation, the Iran conflict and component price hikes all contributed to the three-year low. Europe Smartphone Shipments Share by OEM, Q2 2025 vs Q2 2026 (Counterpoint Research) According to Counterpoint’s estimates, Apple and Samsung each contributed 34% of total smartphone shipments in the region. title: New Samsung Galaxy A08 certification reveals a jump in battery capacity
description: A few days ago the upcoming Samsung Galaxy A08 was spotted in the Google Play Console database. Now it's also been certified by Anatel in Brazil, ahead of its launch over there. The certification reveals that the Galaxy A08 has a battery with a rated capacity of 5,830 mAh, which will be marketed as a typical capacity of 6,000 mAh. That's a significant jump from the Galaxy A07's 5,000 mAh battery. We are of course talking about the 4G models here. Like the A07, the A08 will be powered by the MediaTek Helio G99 SoC, paired with up to 8GB of RAM. The A08 4G actually could be an A07 4G...

description: The Redmi Watch 6 Active last leaked a few days ago, and today it's finally become official. It's already listed in Xiaomi's Chinese online store, and it's up for grabs for CNY 349 (approximately $51). You can get it in Gunmetal, Pink Orange, and Silver colorways. description: Samsung is unveiling the Galaxy S26 FE next week, and the company is also expected to announce the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra very soon, perhaps on the same day or, if not, in early September. Ahead of their release, a reliable source has today revealed the pricing for the two tablets. In the US, the Galaxy Tab S12+ will start at $1,119.99 with 256GB of storage. The 512GB version will set you back $1,399.99. The 5G-capable model with 256GB of storage will be priced at $1,349.99. description: Google’s new Gemini Intelligence AI has a feature called Create My Widget – basically, it takes in a plain language description of what the widget should do, figures out how to do it and places the widget right on your homescreen. Now it looks like Samsung will include a similar (or the same) feature in One UI 9.5. The Samsung version is labeled “My Custom Widget” and can be seen in the screenshot below that was shared by Fahad Ali Javed. description: A leaked demo video recently surfaced online, showcasing how Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods could work. The leak suggested that the new AirPods could debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup next month. Despite the leaked video, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is still targeting a 2027 launch for the camera-equipped AirPods. title: Samsung is now charging up to 15% more for the chips it makes, insiders say
description: The AI boom has gobbled up manufacturing capacity on TSMC’s leading-edge fabs, so companies are turning to Samsung to make their chips – and this has given the company enough leverage to increase its prices by up to 15%, say insiders who spoke to Reuters. In July, Samsung started charging US and Chinese customers 10-15% more for its 4nm node, called SF4, than it did the month before. Companies from Taiwan are looking at 5-10% higher bills. description: The Google Pixel 11 series is now available in stores and from carriers in select regions, following a week of pre-orders. Here’s a look at what the big three US carriers have to offer. T-Mobile is offering the three non-folding models for free – or as the carrier puts it “get the Pixel 11 Pro XL on Us”. This means that it’s $1,300 off, making the base model free. You need to add a new line or trade in an old device (in any condition) and sign up for Experience Beyond 2.0 and Go5G Next. description: Today the prolific leaker who goes by Digital Chat Station on Weibo has shared some new information about Honor's upcoming device ranges. description: As promised, Nothing's CMF sub-brand has unveiled its latest pair of wireless earbuds in India. The CMF Buds Neo offer a distinctive design, active noise cancellation (ANC), and a claimed 52 hours of total playback time. The CMF Buds Neo feature an in-ear design with 12.4mm dynamic drivers. Meanwhile, the charging case sports a square design with rounded corners, a circular dial, and a lanyard hole. description: Huawei's rumored non-folding smartphone with a wide aspect ratio is now official. The company has unveiled the Pura X View featuring a wide form factor and a display with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio. The Huawei Pura X View is the world's first non-folding smartphone with a wide display. In terms of design, the phone bears a resemblance to the Pura X. While Huawei has yet to reveal the complete specifications, the Pura X View features a display with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio and a resolution of 2,232 × 1,320 pixels. title: Sony is launching a new Xperia phone next week
description: Sony is set to add a new member to its Xperia lineup next week. The brand announced a new Xperia launch set for Tuesday, August 25. The event will be livestreamed on YouTube and is set to begin at 11AM Japan time, which corresponds to 4 AM CEST on August 26 in Europe. Sony didn’t explicitly mention the device in question but according to recent leaks, it should be the Xperia 10 VIII (MK8). Last year’s Xperia 10 VII (MK7) launched in September, which would make the Xperia 10 VIII launch nearly a month early.
